scenarios.title: Navigate to page information using navigation bar
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to quickly access page information through direct navigation
preconditions: User is on the AWS World homepage
Navigation bar is visible and functional
steps: User views the navigation bar on the homepage
User clicks on a navigation item to fetch page information
System retrieves and displays the requested page information
scenarios.expected_result: User successfully accesses the desired page information directly through the navigation bar

scenarios.title: Browse new AWS items in What's New section
scenarios.business_objective: Keep users informed about latest AWS offerings and updates
preconditions: User is on the AWS World homepage
What's New section is populated with current AWS items
steps: User navigates to the What's New section on the homepage
User browses through the list of new AWS items
User selects a specific new item to view details
scenarios.expected_result: User successfully views and accesses information about new AWS items

scenarios.title: View client showcase through image carousel
scenarios.business_objective: Display AWS client success stories through visual presentation
preconditions: User is on the AWS World homepage
Image carousel is loaded with client images
steps: User views the image carousel on the homepage
User navigates through carousel images showing specific clients
User clicks on a client image to view more details
scenarios.expected_result: User successfully views client information through the interactive image carousel

scenarios.title: Read customer success stories through story cards
scenarios.business_objective: Showcase customer experiences and build trust through testimonials
preconditions: User is on the AWS World homepage
Customer Story Cards section is populated with stories
steps: User scrolls to the Customer Story Cards section
User browses available customer story cards
User clicks on a specific story card to read the full customer story
scenarios.expected_result: User successfully accesses and reads detailed customer stories through the card interface

scenarios.title: Explore AWS products information from homepage
scenarios.business_objective: Provide users with comprehensive AWS product information access
preconditions: User is on the AWS World homepage
AWS product information is available and accessible
steps: User arrives at the AWS World homepage
User explores available AWS product information sections
User selects and reviews specific AWS product details
scenarios.expected_result: User successfully discovers and accesses comprehensive AWS product information from the homepage
